Data to analyze:
- Email headers and content
- URLs and attachments
- Sender reputation
- Threat intelligence correlation

1. Executive summary
2. Technical findings

4. Recommended actions"

  "title": "User Activity Analysis",
  "description": "Analyze user behavior for signs of compromise after phishing exposure.

Investigation areas:
1. Login patterns in last 7 days (unusual times/locations/IPs)
2. Email sending behavior (volume, recipients, attachments)
3. Account changes (password reset, MFA changes, forwarding rules)
4. Data access (unusual file access, downloads)

Data sources to check:
- Mailcow logs: /var/log/mailcow.log
- Login from new locations
- Email forwarding rules set
- Suspicious outbound emails",

}
